item.title: Macron's viral slap was over texts with Iranian actress, book claims
item.description:
A French political journalist claims the viral slap Brigitte Macron gave her husband at a Vietnamese airport stemmed from jealousy over his messages with Iranian-French actress Golshifteh Farahani – directly contradicting Macron's own account.
